description: Presidential Secretariat - Appoint Four Members Including Justice Hector Yapa as Commissioners of the Mediation Boards Commission
categorisation: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments of named individuals as Commissioners of the Mediation Boards Commission) with basic titles only ("Commissioners," "Chairman"). It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, which would make it a Hybrid (Type 3). The content focuses exclusively on who is being appointed without specifying what they are responsible for beyond their general titles.
